items.title: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.1：代理任務成本降 45%
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.1 with 45% Cost Reduction on Agentic Tasks
items.summary: Fable 5.1 即日全面開放，代理任務成本最高降 45%，推理、程式碼及多語言基準成績刷新。Mythos 5.1 限核准合作夥伴。
items.summary_en: Claude Fable 5.1 is now generally available with up to 45% lower costs on agentic tasks, setting new benchmarks in reasoning, coding, and multilingual performance. Mythos 5.1 is limited to approved partners.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 用 Claude API 做 AI 自動化嘅 agency，成本即降，可重新 pitch AI 增值服務。
items.why_en: Agencies running Claude API workflows get an immediate cost break — update pricing in your AI service proposals now.

items.title: Anthropic 推出企業前沿安全防護 EFS：零數據留存＋客戶自管加密
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Enterprise Frontier Safety: Zero Data Retention for Fortune 100 Clients
items.summary: EFS 提供零數據留存及客戶自管加密，逾百家 Fortune 100 企業（含 Comcast、KPMG、萬事達卡、Salesforce）共同參與研發，免費附加，秋季分階段推出。
items.summary_en: Enterprise Frontier Safety (EFS) offers zero data retention and customer-managed encryption, co-developed with 100+ Fortune 100 companies including Comcast, KPMG, Mastercard, and Salesforce. Free add-on, rolling out in phases this fall.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 企業客戶對 AI 數據合規愈來愈敏感，EFS 係 pitch 大客嘅新說服點。
items.why_en: Enterprise clients increasingly demand AI data compliance — EFS gives you a credible security pitch for regulated-industry accounts.

items.title: Google 發布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 及 Flash Cyber：六週第三款 Flash 模型
items.title_en: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash Cyber: Third Flash Model in Six Weeks
items.summary: Gemini 3.8 Flash 入門定價 $0.75/$3.75（百萬 token），優惠期至 2026 年底。Flash Cyber 係網絡安全專版，限受信任防禦者使用。
items.summary_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash launches at $0.75/$3.75 per million tokens with a discount through end of 2026. Flash Cyber is a cybersecurity-specialized variant available only to trusted defenders.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 低成本 Flash 適合大批量廣告文案生成及分析任務，可接入現有工作流節省成本。
items.why_en: Gemini 3.8 Flash's low token cost makes it ideal for high-volume ad copy generation and analytics pipelines — integrate it now.

items.title: OpenAI 新模型 Astra「隱性遞歸推理」引發安全透明度爭議
items.title_en: OpenAI's Astra Model Sparks Safety Debate Over Hidden Recursive Reasoning
items.summary: OpenAI Astra 採用不可見思維鏈嘅遞歸推理，Redwood Research 等安全機構警告透明度危機，Anthropic 及 Google DeepMind 已就應對展開討論。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Astra model uses invisible recursive reasoning chains, raising transparency concerns from Redwood Research and others. Anthropic and Google DeepMind are now in discussions on a coordinated response.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 決策透明度係客戶信任核心，密切留意業界共識，提前備好合規解說。
items.why_en: AI decision transparency is now a client-trust issue — monitor industry consensus and prepare compliance talking points for major accounts.

items.title: 加州通過 20+ 項 AI 及社媒監管法案，等候州長簽署
items.title_en: California Passes 20+ AI and Social Media Bills Pending Governor's Signature
items.summary: 新法涵蓋禁止針對未成年人成癮性設計、強制 AI 透明度披露、規管自動化招聘，具全美示範效應，廣告平台需調整合規措施。
items.summary_en: Bills cover bans on addictive design targeting minors, mandatory AI transparency disclosures, and regulated automated hiring — setting a national benchmark that ad platforms will need to comply with.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 加州法案走向直接影響美國平台廣告規則，及早了解合規要求保護客戶利益。
items.why_en: California's AI bills set the blueprint for US platform ad regulations — brief clients in regulated industries before the rules take effect.

items.title: Google AI Max 自動升級已生效：帳戶正被 AI 接管
items.title_en: Google AI Max Auto-Upgrade Is Live: AI Now Controls Query Matching and Ad Copy
items.summary: 未退出嘅廣告主帳戶已自動遷移至 AI Max，AI 接管查詢比對、文案及到達頁決策。Google 稱平均提升 7% 轉化，廣泛觸及或帶來不相關流量。
items.summary_en: Accounts that didn't opt out have been auto-migrated to Google AI Max, with AI now controlling query matching, ad copy, and landing page decisions. Google claims +7% conversions on average, though broader matching may bring irrelevant traffic.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 客戶 SEM 帳戶已被自動接管，要即刻審計負面關鍵字同出稿策略，防預算漏洞。
items.why_en: Client SEM accounts have been auto-upgraded — audit negative keywords and campaign controls immediately to prevent budget leakage.

items.title: 微信灰度測試「AI 幫寫」與「AI 點評」，AI 入口增至 16 個
items.title_en: WeChat Tests AI Caption Writer and Comment Suggester in Moments, Reaches 16 AI Touchpoints
items.summary: 微信灰度測試「AI 幫寫」（上傳相片後自動生成三款文風文案）及「AI 點評」（長按動態獲現成評論），AI 入口總數增至 16 個，覆蓋六大社交場景。
items.summary_en: WeChat is testing 'AI Writing' (auto-generates Moments captions in three styles after photo upload) and 'AI Comment' (long-press for suggested replies), bringing its total AI touchpoints to 16 across six social scenarios.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 微信 AI 文案普及後品牌內容同質化風險升，差異化創作策略要提前部署。
items.why_en: As AI-generated WeChat content scales, brand differentiation through creative strategy becomes harder — rethink your content positioning now.

items.title: 抖音 9 月 1 日算法大亂：服務器異常致推薦系統崩潰
items.title_en: Douyin Algorithm Crashes on Sept 1: Server Fault Floods Feeds with Mismatched Content
items.summary: 抖音由 8 月 31 日晚起出現大規模算法故障，用戶首頁被推送完全不符興趣嘅內容，知情人士確認係服務器突發異常，截至 9 月 2 日官方未發通報。
items.summary_en: Starting August 31, Douyin suffered a major algorithm failure — users' feeds flooded with completely unrelated content. Sources confirmed a sudden server anomaly. No official statement was issued by September 2.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 算法崩潰期間廣告觸及大跌、CPM 或飆升，要立即監察客戶投放成效。
items.why_en: Algo failures tank reach and spike CPMs — check client Douyin campaign performance now for anomalies in the affected window.

items.title: Instagram 強制 AI 虛擬人物標籤，不標籤即削減觸及
items.title_en: Instagram Enforces AI Profile Labeling — Undisclosed AI Accounts Face Reach Penalties
items.summary: AI 虛擬 KOL 帳號不標籤即遭懲罰，Reels 及 Explore 推薦曝光大幅降低。品牌若委託 AI 虛擬人物投放，需即刻審查合規狀況。
items.summary_en: AI virtual influencer accounts that fail to disclose their AI nature face algorithmic reach penalties on Reels and Explore. Brands using AI personas must audit compliance immediately.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 用 AI 虛擬 KOL 做 IG 推廣嘅客戶，唔標籤就削減觸及，要即刻補標籤合規。
items.why_en: Clients running AI influencer accounts on Instagram must add disclosures now — non-compliant profiles face immediate reach suppression.

items.title: TikTok TopView 開放自助投放覆蓋 23 市場，Pulse Mentions 同步推出
items.title_en: TikTok TopView Now Self-Serve in 23 Markets, Pulse Mentions Launches for Brand-Adjacent Placements
items.summary: TopView 廣告毋須銷售代表，直接在 Ads Manager 購買，支援排除最多 40% 子地區。Pulse Mentions 令品牌廣告可緊貼提及品牌嘅熱門內容投放。
items.summary_en: TikTok TopView is now self-serve via Ads Manager in 23 markets, with up to 40% sub-regional exclusion controls. Pulse Mentions lets brand ads run adjacent to trending content that already mentions the brand.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: Q4 前開放自助 TopView，agency 可即刻幫客戶搶位，唔需要再等銷售代表。
items.why_en: Self-serve TopView ahead of Q4 means you can book premium placements directly for clients without going through a TikTok rep.

items.title: OpenAI 確認 Sora API 9 月 24 日終止，工作流必須遷移
items.title_en: OpenAI Confirms Sora API Shuts Down September 24 — Migrate Workflows Before the Deadline
items.summary: 繼今年 4 月 Sora 網頁版停服後，OpenAI 確認 Sora API 將於 9 月 24 日正式關閉，逾期數據永久刪除，接入者需於截止日前完成遷移。
items.summary_en: Following the Sora web app shutdown in April 2026, OpenAI confirms the Sora API closes September 24. All user data will be permanently deleted at that point — developers must migrate before the deadline.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: 有接 Sora API 嘅創意工作流，9 月 24 前要搬去 Runway 或可靈，唔搬系統停用。
items.why_en: Any agency workflows built on Sora API break on Sept 24 — migrate to Runway or Kling before the deadline to avoid production downtime.

items.title: Google 推出 AI 設計工具，以提示詞一鍵生成行銷視覺
items.title_en: Google Launches Prompt-Driven AI Design Tool to Challenge Canva for Marketing Visuals
items.summary: Google 新 AI 設計工具純靠提示詞生成視覺素材及行銷物料，毋須設計技能，定位直接挑戰 Canva，為行銷人員提供低門檻創作選項。
items.summary_en: Google's new AI design tool generates marketing visuals and materials from prompts alone, requiring no design skills. It directly targets Canva's market and opens up low-barrier creative production for marketers.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: 行銷人員唔靠設計師可以自行出稿，小型客戶服務效率大增，值得即刻試用。
items.why_en: Marketers can now generate campaign visuals without designers — test it for quick-turnaround briefs to reduce creative bottlenecks.

items.title: 可靈 Image 3.0 Omni 上線：原生 4K 圖像＋系列連拍模式
items.title_en: Kling Image 3.0 Omni Launches Native 4K Generation and Series Mode for Brand Campaigns
items.summary: 可靈 AI 推出 Image 3.0 Omni，支援原生 4K 圖像生成（非放大）及「系列模式」，可按敘事順序生成連貫圖像組，適合廣告分鏡及社媒系列內容製作。
items.summary_en: Kling Image 3.0 Omni offers native 4K image generation (not upscaled) and a new Series Mode that produces sequential, narrative image sets — ideal for campaign storyboards and social media content series.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: 品牌社媒系列圖嘅製作速度可以快幾倍，即刻試用慳返設計同後期時間。
items.why_en: Generate coherent 4K brand image series in minutes — test it for your next social campaign to cut design production time significantly.

items.title: Runway 上架 Wan 3.0 API（含原生音頻），新增 ACEScg EXR 專業輸出
items.title_en: Runway Adds Wan 3.0 with Native Audio to Dev API and Launches ACEScg EXR HDR Output
items.summary: Runway Dev API 加入 Wan 3.0，支援文字、圖像及影片混合輸入並附原生音頻。8 月 31 日另新增 ACEScg EXR 專業級高動態輸出，適合廣播及電影流程。
items.summary_en: Runway's Dev API now includes Wan 3.0 with native audio support for text, image, and video inputs. ACEScg EXR delivery was added August 31 — a professional HDR format for broadcast and film pipelines.
items.section: 創意生產工具
items.why: Runway 多模態 API 成熟，可接駁 agency 自家創意工作流，慳實拍及後期成本。
items.why_en: Runway's multimodal API now covers audio, image, and video — integrate it into your creative pipeline to cut production costs.

items.title: 百事可樂 17 億美元全球媒體帳戶易主：宏盟出局、Publicis 接手
items.title_en: PepsiCo's $1.7B Global Media Account Moves to Publicis — Omnicom Loses 25-Year Client
items.summary: 百事可樂不經比稿直接委任 Publicis，終止宏盟 25 年合作，AI 驅動統一媒體模型成為大型廣告主選代理新標準，宏盟股價跌約 5%。
items.summary_en: PepsiCo awarded its $1.7B global media account to Publicis without a pitch, ending a 25-year partnership with Omnicom. AI-driven unified media modeling is now the baseline agency selection criterion; Omnicom shares fell ~5%.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: AI 驅動媒體模型成選代理標準，agency 要加速建立自家 AI 媒體能力應對競爭。
items.why_en: AI-driven media modeling is now a baseline requirement for large account pitches — agencies without it are structurally disadvantaged.

items.title: 伊藤忠擬 13 億美元私有化電通數碼，電通警示 AI 原生代理競爭加劇
items.title_en: Itochu Plans $1.3B Privatization of Dentsu Digital as Dentsu Flags Rising AI Agency Threat
items.summary: 伊藤忠商事擬以 13 億美元收購電通數碼令其退市，電通同步公開警示 AI 原生代理威脅持續升溫，日本代理市場整合加速。
items.summary_en: Itochu plans a $1.3B bid to take Dentsu Digital private. Simultaneously, Dentsu publicly flagged escalating competition from AI-native agencies, as Japan's agency market consolidates rapidly.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 傳統代理整合同 AI 原生新對手崛起，業界格局快速重塑，要留意話語走向。
items.why_en: Traditional agency consolidation plus rising AI-native competition is reshaping the market — monitor global holding group strategies for signals.

items.title: AI 安全企業 HiddenLayer 完成 1 億美元 B 輪，微軟 M12 跟投
items.title_en: AI Security Firm HiddenLayer Closes $100M Series B Backed by Microsoft M12
items.summary: HiddenLayer 由 Delta-v Capital 領投完成 1 億美元 B 輪，Microsoft M12、摩根士丹利跟投，專注企業 AI 模型安全防護，顯示 AI 安全賽道資金持續湧入。
items.summary_en: HiddenLayer closed a $100M Series B led by Delta-v Capital with Microsoft M12 and Morgan Stanley participating. The firm specializes in enterprise AI model security, signaling sustained investor interest in AI safety infrastructure.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: AI 安全投資升溫，企業客戶採購 AI 工具時合規要求將更嚴，agency 要提前了解。
items.why_en: Growing AI security investment means enterprise clients will apply stricter compliance requirements to AI tools — factor this into your service stack.

items.title: 宏盟媒體集團任命亞太首席策略官，強化 APAC 領導層
items.title_en: Omnicom Media Group Appoints APAC Chief Strategy Officer to Strengthen Regional Leadership
items.summary: David McCallen 出任 Omnicom Media Group 亞太首席策略官，於百事可樂帳戶易主風波前夕補充高層班底，鞏固 APAC 業務佈局。
items.summary_en: David McCallen is appointed as Omnicom Media Group's APAC Chief Strategy Officer, bolstering senior leadership ahead of the PepsiCo account loss announcement.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 宏盟 APAC 高層人事變動，業界格局微調，有意合作或競標嘅 agency 要留意。
items.why_en: Omnicom's APAC senior reshuffle signals strategic repositioning — monitor if key talent moves affect regional pitch dynamics.

items.title: Google AI Max 生效後：即刻要做嘅 4 個帳戶審計步驟
items.title_en: Google AI Max Is Live: 4 Immediate Campaign Audit Steps to Protect Client Budgets
items.summary: AI Max 已自動接管 SEM 帳戶，廣泛比對或帶來預算浪費。即行動：①審計負面關鍵字列表 ②確認品牌詞保護 ③核實到達頁自動替換範圍 ④設定成效警報。
items.summary_en: Google AI Max has auto-migrated accounts. Act now: (1) audit negative keyword lists, (2) check brand term protection settings, (3) verify landing page auto-substitution scope, (4) set up performance alerts for the first week.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: AI Max 生效首周最易出現預算浪費，做足審計步驟可即刻保護客戶帳戶。
items.why_en: The first week after AI Max migration is highest-risk for budget waste — these four checks protect client accounts immediately.

items.title: Sora API 停服倒計時：Runway、可靈同混合方案比較
items.title_en: Sora API Shutdown Countdown: Comparing Runway, Kling, and Hybrid Migration Options
items.summary: 9 月 24 日前有三條遷移路：①Runway Gen-4 API（多模態已商用）②可靈 Video API（中國生態整合佳）③混用策略（國際創意用 Runway，中國生態用可靈）。視乎工作流選擇。
items.summary_en: Three migration paths before Sept 24: (1) Runway Gen-4 API — fully commercial, strong multimodal support; (2) Kling Video API — better China ecosystem integration; (3) hybrid strategy — Runway for international, Kling for China-facing workflows.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 9 月 24 日係硬截止，依照工作流需求揀好替代方案，今日就開始測試。
items.why_en: Sept 24 is a hard deadline — pick your migration path today and start testing to avoid production downtime when Sora API goes offline.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 降價 45%：agency 4 大規模化應用場景
items.title_en: Claude Fable 5.1 Costs 45% Less: 4 High-ROI Use Cases to Scale Up for Agency Teams
items.summary: 成本降 45% 後可規模化：大批量廣告文案測試、多語言素材生成、客戶簡報自動摘要、社媒評論批量草稿，以前唔划算嘅任務而家可自動化。
items.summary_en: With agentic costs down 45%, scale up: (1) high-volume ad copy A/B testing, (2) multilingual asset regeneration, (3) automated client brief summarization, (4) bulk social comment reply drafting — tasks previously too costly are now viable at scale.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: 成本降 45% 後以前唔划算嘅 AI 任務可規模化，係提升 ROI 嘅好時機。
items.why_en: Tasks previously too costly to automate at scale are now viable — use this price drop to expand AI coverage across client workflows.

items.title: 微信 AI 幫寫普及後：品牌帳號保持差異化嘅 3 個做法
items.title_en: WeChat AI Writing Scales Up: 3 Ways Brand Accounts Can Stay Differentiated
items.summary: AI 幫寫普及後同質化風險升。品牌可：建 prompt 框架嵌入品牌語氣、設人手審核關卡、結合獨家品牌圖片及品牌詞確保內容差異。
items.summary_en: As WeChat AI Writing scales, homogenization risk rises. Brand accounts should: (1) build prompt frameworks with embedded brand voice instructions, (2) set up human review checkpoints to catch AI drift, (3) anchor content to proprietary brand assets like product imagery and brand vocabulary.
items.section: 即學技巧 & 玩法
items.why: AI 幫寫大規模後，有品牌個性嘅內容才搶眼，即刻建立 prompt 框架保持差異。
items.why_en: When AI levels the content playing field, brand voice is your edge — set up structured prompts and review workflows before homogenization kicks in.
